items.title: Newsom to campaign across New Hampshire on Saturday, Oct 17 for midterm Democrats
items.summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom (D-CA) will campaign across New Hampshire on Saturday, Oct 17, 2026 - voter rallies, canvassing launches and fundraisers - including an Exeter voter-mobilization event with Senate candidate Rep. Chris Pappas, a Nashua canvassing launch with Pappas and gubernatorial nominee Cinde Warmington at a field office funded via Newsom's political arm, and an evening meet-and-greet with congressional candidate Stefany Shaheen. His team says he has raised $6.5M+ for Democrats nationally this cycle and funneled $526K+ to NH Democrats via 23,500+ contributions. The visit doubles as early 2028 positioning: the DNC's approved 2028 calendar puts NH third, after SC and NV. Reported Oct 13 (NY Post, 8:27 pm ET); Pluribus AM cites WMUR.
